title: OUT OF LIFE
tagline: the maze, the haze, the fall, the ember

dramatic.two_seconds_before: the maze, the haze, the fall, the ember. Before frame 1 we are already inside 'THE SEARCH': the city was moving before the camera arrived, so the opening beat is a stimulus already in progress, not a cold start.

beats.verb: something in the world changes — building against sky, window
the body/camera loads against the coming move — building against mountain, cloud
beats.line: The vape gathers, inside and out. My vision blurs. I move toward the window — and you only get further away. More haze.

beats.verb: the move reaches its extreme — building against sky
beats.line: It was the maze, constructed by a tainted love. You fall off the fire escape, into darkness — and the city streaks upward like it

beats.verb: the move lands and overshoots — building against wall, window
beats.line: I trip on my own words, falling out of life — and find where you go when you leave. The gap between us breathes, and never closes.

flip_test.note: keys must differ enough to tell the story with no in-betweens
